column3: line 61 returns -1 for modes outside 0-4 and the prose names that path, but the formal requires 0 <= pi->mode <= 4, so the -1 path is excluded from the formal contract.

lines 886-888 and 900-902 call svc_exit_thread only on the current rqstp, and threads started in earlier loop iterations keep running, so the prose claim that partially created threads are exited is false.
line 1687 sets done from dma->channel_program and line 1702 returns it, so nonzero means the channel was programmed, not that the DMA transfer is complete as the prose claims.

lines 396-397 send buffers under SZ_4K to pci_epf_mhi_iatu_write, which copies with memcpy_toio and calls buf_info->cb (lines 291, 298-299), so the claim that the bytes were DMA'd misses that path and its callback side effect.
the formal ensures (result == 0 ==> *pengine != NULL) does not exclude negative returns; it is weaker than the prose but not false, and line 41 only forwards to nvkm_msvld_new_.

lines 1048-1052 let SNDCTL_DSP_SPEED change the speed after checking ownership only, with no queues_are_quiescent check, which contradicts the prose rule that parameter changes need ownership and quiescence.
lines 251 and 253 return only false or true, so ensures result == 0 || result == 1 is correct; it is weaker than the prose but not false.
line 407 takes a reference on mem_node with of_find_node_by_path, and no of_node_put follows on any path (lines 476-484), so failure paths do not unwind all resources as the prose claims.
line 51 rejects only slot > 0, so negative slots go on to the register access at lines 57-63, which contradicts the prose claim that negative slots are rejected.
line 338 masks the VSA value with 0xFE, which can be 0, and line 339 then returns 0 << 20 == 0, so ensures result > 0 is false.

with force_change false, line 1053 sets changed = pre_features ^ features, so a feature that is successfully disabled leaves (changed & ~features) != 0 while line 1112 returns 0, which falsifies the formal ensures.
line 205 returns failure_state & (FAILURE_LOW_OVERTEMP | FAILURE_HIGH_OVERTEMP), so the formal ensures holds; leaving out the side effects makes it weaker but not false.
lines 199-201 compute ent from v and dereference it, so requires true wrongly claims the function is safe for any v and drops the prose precondition that v is a valid ei_entry node.

line 177 stores the result of devm_snd_soc_register_card, which line 183 returns, and lines 154 and 167 return -EINVAL, but the prose postcondition says without condition that the card is registered and names no error return.
line 454 returns the result of nubus_driver_register, and ensures result == 0 || result < 0 states only the sign, which is weaker than the prose but not false.
line 361 sets curack only when CC_ALGO(tp)->ack_received is non-NULL, and line 317 restricts the ABC flag handling to type == CC_ACK, but the prose states both as unconditional updates.
lines 6222-6226 return QLA_SUCCESS when ql4xdisablesysfsboot is set without creating boot_kset, any kobjects or scsi_host references, which contradicts the prose success postcondition.

line 758 updates self_powered only in USB_MODE_HOST, and the unconfigure path (lines 694-697) never updates power or self_powered, so the prose claim that both are updated on success is not guaranteed.
lines 531-532 dereference fd and fd->fd_rh, so requires true wrongly claims safety for any fd and drops the prose precondition that fd points to a valid fib_data.

line 3836 parses into an unsigned long but line 3840 stores it in ksm_advisor_max_cpu, an unsigned int (printed with %u at line 3826), so values above UINT_MAX are truncated and the knob does not equal the parsed value.
